# Daily Paraswap News

> Daily reporting on decentralized exchange flows, ParaSwap routing, liquidity shifts and trading costs, with on-chain evidence for active crypto traders.

Coverage: Swap Routing, DEX Liquidity, Trading Costs, Protocol Governance, Onchain Flows.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://dailycryptonews.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://dailycryptonews.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://dailycryptonews.github.io/archive/): everything published.
